# FOLR: entity-history family OPEN

**PRO_FINAL / OWNER_DELEGATED: OPEN** one observer-owned entity-history-before-
aggregation B family against equally informed adaptive generic RETAIN on the
explicitly lifecycle-identity-visible native Traffic Junction variant.
Original-DM scientific/specification intake found no material conflict.

Read the [immutable complete response](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/3bc6fb929f43463eddd37dc4584951896c08fe3e/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260912_entity_history_continuity/archive/RESPONSE.md)
and [accepted intake and decision-ready investment need](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/2d95d09b74f311c52122ebd0abc991ac261d5eb4/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260912_entity_history_continuity/INTAKE.md).
The [fixed task](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/e029de7154260a773710385b8ad74587bcfcbe33/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260912_entity_history_continuity/delivery/TASK.md)
and every declared input remain unchanged.

The selected bank has one shared GRU16 cell per observer-subject lifetime,
local visible updates, unchanged invisible carry, and state/bookkeeping cuts
at subject or observer replacement. One observer-local attention readout has
a direct current-feature path and no additional pooled GRU. Generic RETAIN
keeps its adaptive GRU64. Both arms receive the same complete public lifecycle
table and local visibility/seen/age information, with no unseen physical data
or other actor's hidden state. This is a whole-package question, not a matched
component-cause claim or a new experimental result.

FOLR continues ACTIVE. This is a distinct family OPEN, not a direction RECAST
or a reopening of LEARNED_EVENT. Preserve the old narrow H, all B01-B03
observations, B04 generic competence and older fixed-half/blanket-clear pauses.
No Portfolio lifecycle, priority, recast history, C or UAV field changes.

The next need is a finite implementation/acceptance batch plus one real matched
training pair and sampled final native returns, through the appropriate
investment route. Source-sized 5000 train/128 final per arm and practical MEI1
are prospective reference sizing, not a new frozen card or grant. Implementation,
per-arm wall, support, memory and complete cost remain unknown. The current
consultation allocated no implementation, model construction, numerical work,
experiment, test, scientific seed, fourth unchanged scalar pair or repeat
consultation. The owner need not ratify each conforming application.

The response and its existing delivery comment are preserved. Earlier body
snapshots and comments retain their historical meaning; this body records the
current accepted family scope and its actual investment boundary.
